title: About · Creosote Labs
meta_description: Creosote Labs is an AI and operations consultancy founded by Brian Burke, former COO of a venture-backed technology startup.
intro: Creosote Labs is an AI and operations consultancy. We work with owner-operated businesses to replace spreadsheets and manual processes with systems that fit how they operate, build the websites and applications they need, and train their teams to use AI tools in their day-to-day work.
founder_text: Brian Burke was previously chief operating officer of a venture-backed technology startup.
